title: The Hidden Room
subtitle: invisible, until you have already touched it
description: There is a room off the alley that is not on the market's own map,
and the quest for it demonstrates the easter-egg case:
hidden entirely until at least one of its tasks has progress, and
then it appears on the canvas with nothing pointing at it.
That is the one way a quest can surface with no dependency edge to
explain it, and it is how this market prefers to advertise: the
first sign that the room exists is the first thing you have
